What Is a VPC? A Private Room for Your Servers, Explained

Quick thread 🧵
A VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) is your own private, isolated network inside the cloud.
Public-facing things like your web app go in a *public subnet*.
Sensitive things like your database and cache go in a *private subnet* with no public address.
Your app reaches the database over an internal private IP, and the open internet has no route to it.
